text: We found that plants generally benefited from soil microbes, and this benefit was greater whenever their current watering conditions matched the microbes' historical watering conditions. Principally, the plant's presence was not necessary in the historical treatments for this environmental matching benefit to emerge. Moreover, we found microbes from droughted soils could better tolerate drought stress.
